label: Analytic validity; testable universal…: AnalyticValid F: every analytic sentence is true at every…
definition: `AnalyticValid F`: every analytic sentence is true at every world. `HasTestableLaw F`: the language has a universal law in a law setting (DEF-UNIVERSAL-LAW-SETTING) and an individual a with observation statements R a and notB (true exactly where B a is false) that hold together at some world.
note: Stipulative: what the V1 package holds of its empirical language. That analytic sentences are tautologies is the positivists' account of analyticity; that a scientific language contains testable universal laws ('arsenic is poisonous', 'all men are mortal', AYER-LTL-PELICAN-I-18-LAWS) is common to the V1 proponent and his critics.
